title: Split the full-ring re-raise spots into own-raise-re-raised and re-raised-when-I-had-not-raised
description: Follow-up from TASK-7.21 (decision: Q-1 split re-raise), after the 6-max split. Apply the same A-2 rule and the situation names, labels and context sentences from the 6-max story to the full-ring chart: 41 to 50 spots (+9), with 9 new grids and the 9 existing re-raise grids re-justified. Cost table and affected code/locked tests: doit/TASK-7.21/spec.md §3 and §5. Heads-up is unchanged (every heads-up re-raise is an own-raise re-raise). The spec must ask the user for wording of any new label or context text the 6-max story did not already settle, and the user signs off the new and changed spots from npm run chart:print full-ring, as in TASK-7.19. Related: TASK-7.38 (full-ring chart review).

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given a full-ring hand with two or more preflop raises, When preflop advice is computed, Then it reads the own-raise-re-raised spot if the viewer made a preflop raise that a later raise now faces, and the re-raised-when-I-had-not-raised spot otherwise (TASK-7.21 rule A-2)

Given the full-ring chart, When the split is authored, Then it has 50 spots, each with all 169 hand classes and a plain-English justification that agrees with its grid, and each own-raise-re-raised spot continues with a share of that seat's opening range that the user approves
Given any new user-visible label or context text, When shown, Then its wording was approved by the user in this story's Q&A
Given the golden spots, When npm test runs, Then at least one full-ring golden spot covers each re-raise situation
Given the revised chart, When npm test runs, Then all checks pass and the user has signed off the new and changed full-ring spots from npm run chart:print full-ring in the task notes

Given a 6-max or full-ring hand where the viewer has not raised and a fourth bet is already in (e.g. BB facing r(4,8) r(5,12) r(6,16) f(1) f(2)), When preflop advice is computed, Then it reads re-raise-not-mine and a raise cell (AA) is advised call because the betting is capped
